description: This 3D bar chart illustrates the "Accuracy" of different language models across various types of reasoning. The chart features three axes. The vertical value axis is labeled "Accuracy" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to slightly above 0.6, with numeric tick marks at regular intervals of 0.2 (0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6). There are two horizontal category axes forming the base of the 3D plot. The left-facing axis lists three models in the following order: "Davinci-003", "ChatGPT", and "BARD". The right-facing axis lists four reasoning categories in the following order: "Inductive", "Abductive", "Deductive", and "Mix". The data is represented by a 3 by 4 grid of vertical bars, with one bar positioned at each intersection of a model and a reasoning category. The bars are colored using a height-based gradient, transitioning from dark blue at the base (near a value of 0) through light blue, green, and yellow, reaching orange at the highest peaks. The shortest bar corresponds to the ChatGPT model in the Inductive category, with an approximate value of 0.2. The tallest bars reach an approximate value of 0.7, which can be observed in the Davinci-003 Deductive category and the ChatGPT Mix category. The bars are not sorted by height, but rather follow the fixed categorical order of the base axes, and all bars are outlined in thin black lines without any specific visual emphasis applied to individual data points.
